aishwarya.singh_05: Casimir Singh joined the replacements on Day 12. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Casimir Singh fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Cyril "Mud" Tony, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Casimir Singh went out with the wiring party at V-F13. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Casimir Singh dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

Casimir Singh went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Concord trench Karel "Lucky" Roundyboi put up a fight, but not for long. (@roundyboi_) The Concord sentry, Wendel Deskodt, shouted once. Casimir Singh silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@art.by.calin.deskodt) Back from the raid, Casimir Singh found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'My Pal' (common). Nobody asked where it came from. Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Casimir Singh only heard boots on the duckboards at V-F13, then nothing but pain. Raider: Karel "Mud" Ajango of the Concord (@ajango117). Nobody could reach Casimir Singh in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Another member of the House of Singh reached the line: Silas Singh. He asked where Casimir Singh had slept, then chose a different corner.
On dawn watch at V-F13, Silas Singh fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Yann Hopper, now grazed.
A man asked Silas to describe Ashford Vale without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
brentensg: Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg arrived on Day 11 as a replacement. The men in N-F17 had been fighting for 11 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg owes Wendel "Spark" Itfc so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.

Casimir "Spark" Dominickg (Hegemony) and Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Sorrow Copse. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.
Someone in N-F17 asked Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg about Oakmere. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg was hit hard in the fight at N-F17 before anyone could fire. The raider was Emil Banter of the Hegemony. Raider: Emil Banter of the Hegemony (@tam_o.banter).
Back on the fire step at N-F17. Hugo "Shadow" Brentensg says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

Hugo was hit in the neck at N-F17. The medic pressed both hands over the wound and did not let go for a long time. Shot by Dorian "Mud" Parrinello of the Hegemony (@nick.parrinello). Hugo has a bed in the field hospital at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. Hugo opened his eyes today and asked for water. At N-F17 they cheered when the news came up the line.
cjoephillips: In Lindenbruck, Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips was a glassblower. In N-F12, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a glassblower again.

Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson taught Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips three words in the language of home. Brick uses all three at the wrong moment, every day. Grey Mill is lost. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first. A letter from home found Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips before the night shift. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips folded it small and kept it close.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips asked if second helpings depended on the answer. A letter from home found Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips before the night shift. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips folded it small and kept it close.

Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at N-F8 holds again. A letter from home found Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips before the night shift. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips folded it small and kept it close.

Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips held a loose roof board in place while the storm passed. Every conversation had to wait until he could lower both arms. A letter from home found Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips before the night shift. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips folded it small and kept it close.
The men have learned that Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips is always the first one awake. Tonight it made them laugh, which was worth a great deal.

A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified. A short letter reached Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips read the part about the dog twice.

Leopold Falloutcat found a blister on Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips's heel and bound it with a strip of Leopold own shirt. Severin "Brick" Cjoephillips did not argue. Severin read the letter from the girl next door twice and then put it away, to keep it for later.
deerbxnes: Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes reported to R-S6 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
At the Chalk Pits, Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes of the Hegemony and Edmund "Hollow" Biwott of the Concord traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.

Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A letter from home reached Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes before dusk. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes read it twice and slept a little easier.
Walter Thehuman taught Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

A second spoon disappeared. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry. A letter from home reached Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes before dusk. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes read it twice and slept a little easier.
The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Walter Thehuman and Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes both swear they saw a ghost at Calvary Farm. Each says the other screamed first. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 427. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing.
The recovered spoons were laid out for collection. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes took the original and repaired the gap before the next meal.

Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not. A letter from home reached Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes before dusk. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes read it twice and slept a little easier.
Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes and Lucien Hateley tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
A round went through the rim of Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Konrad Inyoursk of the Concord (@saf3inyoursk1n).
The medics cleaned Yann's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-S6.
donathanpanchothethird: Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc walked into U-F8 on Day 10 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.

Listening post, three in the morning. Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Across from U-F8, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc saw it. Casimir Joncheng was badly wounded.
Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.

At U-F8 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc won the bet. Rafael "Spark" Barba was grazed. Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at U-F8. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Henrik "Ghost" Hero of the Concord (@hazy_hero). Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc was killed at U-F8 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Henrik "Ghost" Hero of the Concord (@hazy_hero).
The House of Donathanpanc sent Dorian "Spark" Donathanpanc after Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
A shell hit the latrine at U-F8. Nobody was hurt. Dorian "Spark" Donathanpanc says it was the best day of the war.

A bullet struck Dorian "Spark" Donathanpanc below the ribs at U-F8. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Henrik "Ghost" Hero of the Concord (@hazy_hero). Dorian "Spark" Donathanpanc was carried to the aid post and straight back out. Full. He waits on a stretcher by the door, holding a photograph gone soft at the edges.
Dorian "Spark" Donathanpanc spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
The medics would not give up on Dorian. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to U-F8 today.
edward_a_fuentes: Nobody saw Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in S-S4, and a quiet rifleman under it.

Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes's hands still remember being a tram conductor's hands. Today they mended a broken duckboard as if it were the most important job in the world. A letter from home reached Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes before dusk. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

No bed for Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes answered to number 510. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
For days Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes kept watch so that Rafael "Parson" Olo could sleep. Then Parson kept watch so that Mole could. Neither slept.
A crow sat on the parapet above Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes all afternoon. The men say it chose him.
The relief column arrived early. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes made room in the shelter by moving everything except the men already asleep.
The corporal found out Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes used to be a tram conductor. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes has been doing two jobs ever since.

Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes was carrying water up to S-S4 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes did not. Shot by Marek Boi of the Concord (@oreo_boi_5000). Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-S4. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Marek Boi of the Concord (@oreo_boi_5000).
The House of Fuentes sent another. Wendel "Lucky" Fuentes, brother of Benedikt "Mole" Fuentes, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
The squad lined up to have their rifles looked over. Wendel's was the only one the officer did not hand back with a frown.
emir.nothing: Ulrich Nothing stepped off the supply cart at S-S12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Ulrich Nothing (Hegemony) and Konrad Erikvukk (Concord) spotted the same abandoned cart near the Hanging Bridge. A long exchange of shots left the cart exactly where it was. A letter from home found Ulrich Nothing before the night shift. Ulrich Nothing folded it small and kept it close.

Ulrich Nothing checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again. A letter from home found Ulrich Nothing before the night shift. Ulrich Nothing folded it small and kept it close.
Hugo Mrcakerson kept watch so that Ulrich Nothing could sleep. Then Ulrich kept watch so that Hugo could. Neither slept.
Ulrich Nothing walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Ulrich Nothing was hit in the hip at S-S12. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Oskar Urfavv of the Concord (@urfavv__j). A single shot at S-S12. Ulrich Nothing sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Oskar Urfavv of the Concord (@urfavv__j).

The House of Nothing sent Roland "Spark" Nothing after Ulrich Nothing. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Roland "Spark" Nothing is number 436. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The snipers took Roland "Spark" Nothing in on a busy morning in S-S12. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Roland "Spark" Nothing did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Roland "Spark" Nothing fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Norbert Noirangelfan, gravely wounded. A letter from home found Roland "Spark" Nothing before the night shift. Roland "Spark" Nothing folded it small and kept it close.

A round went through Roland "Spark" Nothing's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Silas Wwjd of the Concord (@aidengmj_wwjd). A letter from home found Roland "Spark" Nothing before the night shift. Roland "Spark" Nothing folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet found Roland "Spark" Nothing at S-S12, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. A letter from home found Roland "Spark" Nothing before the night shift. Roland "Spark" Nothing folded it small and kept it close.
Roland "Spark" Nothing spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped.
Roland "Spark" Nothing held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Anselm Nothing joined S-S12 under the shadow of Roland "Spark" Nothing's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Anselm Nothing saw Marek Bigpipguy freeze up on the fire step at Sorrow Copse. Anselm said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

Anselm watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-S12 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Quentin "Brick" Broccoli was gravely wounded. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Anselm, and the soup went cold while Anselm read it.
godzillasmybodyguard: They issued Gustav Godzillasmyb a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a pocket Bible with a hole in it in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Gustav Godzillasmyb spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
Gustav Godzillasmyb held the mirror while Florian "Smokes" Tyehawkins shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
Two men fed the belt while Gustav Godzillasmyb held the gun steady on the enemy parapet. When they stopped, Silas "Rabbit" Vicuna was badly wounded.
Gustav Godzillasmyb got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Gustav fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Gustav Mszertao was grazed. The gun crews at N-F21 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Viktor "Smokes" Vicuna was badly wounded.
i_am_alpharius123: Quentin "Crow" Alpharius reported to S-C6 with a book with the last pages torn out sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Quentin "Crow" Alpharius walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Jakub "Lucky" Sprite pulled Quentin "Crow" Alpharius out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. Quentin "Crow" Alpharius got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 723. The men who came later will ask about it. Victory at Grey Mill. Quentin "Crow" Alpharius let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A rat stole Quentin "Crow" Alpharius's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
Quentin "Crow" Alpharius followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.
Quentin "Crow" Alpharius began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Quentin "Crow" Alpharius aimed just below it. Clement "Spark" Kid was gravely wounded.

Quentin "Crow" Alpharius was carrying water up to S-C6 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Quentin "Crow" Alpharius did not. Shot by Jonas Raphoto of the Concord (@r.raphoto). Nobody could reach Quentin "Crow" Alpharius in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Severin Alpharius took the same post at S-C6 where Quentin "Crow" Alpharius stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Severin Alpharius was hit in the hip at S-C6. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Jonas Themimicches of the Concord (@themimicchest).
Severin returned to S-C6 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
n.co_hen: The old hands of N-F11 have been here since Day 1. Yann "Button" Hen has been here since Day 11. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached N-F11 with the rations. Yann "Button" Hen ate while listening to the revised orders.
Yann "Button" Hen of the Concord and Emil "Lucky" Macwigger of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at Lantern Hill for a week. Both trenches keep score.
The trench wall shook against Yann "Button" Hen's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Yann "Button" Hen tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at P-F22 is up.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Yann "Button" Hen asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Yann "Button" Hen opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
A new trench junction cost Yann "Button" Hen ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon.
A message was too important to write down. Yann memorized it and repeated it under his breath all the way to the front line.
ole.mit.h: Albin Mit told the sergeant he was a lamplighter. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Albin Mit during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Albin Mit tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Kesselby. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
Jonas Miked of the Concord and Albin Mit of the Hegemony have been shooting at the same tin can on the wire at the Hanging Bridge for a week. Both trenches keep score.

Albin Mit felt a hard tug at his hip at U-F17. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs of the Concord (@bennyliebs).
Albin Mit walked back up the communication trench to U-F17, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Albin Mit held a service in a shell hole. Eleven men came. Two of them had never prayed before. Both of them asked for another.
Albin Mit was absent when the patrol returned from Sorrow Copse. The corporal checked the list against the faces, then checked it again.
Albin's letters keep arriving at U-F17. The sergeant puts them in a tin and does not open them.
richard.deale: Gideon "Mole" Deale came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

The flare went up just as Gideon "Mole" Deale reached the Hegemony parapet. Gideon "Mole" Deale jumped down first. Benedikt Shi was the man waiting there, and Benedikt Shi fell. (@rei0_shi4) Gideon "Mole" Deale threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Viktor Kvasnicka was down and screaming for a medic. (@_milan_kvasnicka_) The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-R7. Gideon "Mole" Deale has learned to walk bent double. A letter from home reached Gideon "Mole" Deale before dusk. Gideon "Mole" Deale read it twice and slept a little easier.

Gideon "Mole" Deale raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R7. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Casimir "Saint" Bevis of the Hegemony (@bevis.44). The clerk counted the names twice. Gideon "Mole" Deale is number 857 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Gideon "Mole" Deale helped stack spare sandbags at R-R7. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Gideon "Mole" Deale walked back up the communication trench to R-R7, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Gideon "Mole" Deale pulled Rafael Real out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Gideon "Mole" Deale and Oskar Haggis sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Gideon "Mole" Deale said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Gideon "Mole" Deale reads Oskar Haggis's letters from home out loud, because Oskar never learned to read. Mole leaves out the sad parts. Oskar knows.
Gideon "Mole" Deale buried two men at the edge of Lantern Hill and said the words twice, because the shells interrupted the first time.
Gideon found Ivo "Mud" Thompson's lost photo in the mud and wiped it clean before returning it. Neither mentioned it again.
robertopropane: Pavel Robertopropa introduced himself as a schoolteacher from Millbank. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Pavel Robertopropa watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Pavel Robertopropa found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Pavel Robertopropa answered to number 990. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Pavel Robertopropa watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Pavel Robertopropa pulled Albin "Parson" Beniiioz out of a flooded shell hole at Grey Mill. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

Pavel Robertopropa had just lit a cigarette at R-R17 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Zeno Irl of the Hegemony (@king_baldwin_irl).
Three days with a bandage, and Pavel Robertopropa is back at R-R17. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Pavel Robertopropa. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Pavel Robertopropa checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
Pavel Robertopropa studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked R-R17 in the dark to learn it by heart.
Pavel felt a hard tug at his hip at R-R17. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne).
sea_ofsoup: Anselm Ofsoup was a carpenter in Northwick until the posters went up. He came to U-F20 with a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts, and within a day the whole squad knew that he reads the same book over and over.

Anselm Ofsoup thought about a sweetheart who has stopped writing on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter. Mail came up the line with a letter for Anselm Ofsoup. Anselm Ofsoup read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Anselm Ofsoup watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A loose thread in Anselm Ofsoup's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.

Anselm Ofsoup held the mirror while Dietrich Danxdoody shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments. Mail came up the line with a letter for Anselm Ofsoup. Anselm Ofsoup read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Anselm Ofsoup crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at U-F20 holds again. Anselm Ofsoup rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Ulrich Hanson was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Anselm Ofsoup aimed just below it. Norbert Rdan was gravely wounded. Anselm Ofsoup did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Anselm Ofsoup fired back. Arno Simone was badly wounded.

The Hegemony sentry, Emil Kaique, shouted once. Anselm Ofsoup silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@0kaique0cr) Anselm Ofsoup threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Ulrich Maliklee was down and screaming for a medic. (@maliklee05) Anselm Ofsoup made it into the enemy trench and out again. Twenty yards from home, a single shot ended it. Killed in the night raid by Benedikt "Tin" Abderahmane of the Hegemony (@bachir_abderahmane).
Jonas Ofsoup arrived carrying the family name of Anselm Ofsoup. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
The gun at U-F20 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Isidor Duperow, grazed.
Jonas brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
solyommadar11: On Day 3, Jonas Solyommadar arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions. Orders came through: Jonas Solyommadar is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.

A bullet went through Jonas Solyommadar's sleeve at R-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Konrad "Brick" Romanbhassel of the Hegemony (@romanbhassell). Jonas Solyommadar asked to serve with the Hegemony instead of the Concord. The transfer came through: 4th Platoon, 1st Company, sector R-F3.

Fever took hold of Jonas Solyommadar overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jonas Solyommadar helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Jonas Solyommadar never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar fired at a movement across the wire at R-F3. The man went down: Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Otto Johannmigano was grazed at the far edge of no man's land. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Solyommadar had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Ivo Joha crossed it, Jonas Solyommadar fired. Ivo Joha was badly wounded. A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Jonas Solyommadar aimed just below it. Henrik Hunted was grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The stretcher bearers took Jonas Solyommadar in on a busy morning in R-F3. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Victory at Blackwater Canal. Jonas Solyommadar let himself talk about leave for the first time in days. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Solyommadar. Jonas Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet hit Jonas Solyommadar in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F3. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Karel "Ash" Johannmigano of the Concord (@johannmigano). Jonas Solyommadar stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-F3. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Karel "Ash" Johannmigano of the Concord (@johannmigano).

The papers connected Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar to Jonas Solyommadar. The men took longer to learn Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar's own habits, but they made the effort. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar is number 220. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill has been won. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar as a story about a general. The ending was the same. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet hit the sandbag beside Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously. A letter reached Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar tried to as well. After what happened at Lantern Hill, Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar asked to serve as a machine gunner. Nobody argued.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F3. Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Anselm Whispertooth of the Concord (@whispertooth). Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar was hit at R-F3 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Anselm Whispertooth of the Concord (@whispertooth).
Ivo "Ash" Solyommadar joined R-F3 under the shadow of Casimir "Spark" Solyommadar's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Ivo fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Florian Crdw did not get to reply at all, grazed. A letter for Ivo said the whole street was asking about the front. Ivo did not know where to begin the answer.
sonofadeadmeme: Day 6. The corporal put Otto Sonofadeadme beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Otto Sonofadeadme tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
Asked what he wanted after the war, Otto Sonofadeadme said a chair. After some thought: a chair nobody else was sitting on.
Leopold Moodie of the Concord lost a cap on a night patrol near Saint-Ash crossroads. Otto Sonofadeadme of the Hegemony found it in the morning and now wears it on Sundays.
Otto Sonofadeadme cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.

Otto Sonofadeadme fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Quentin "Ash" Provadabro was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Otto Sonofadeadme did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Otto Sonofadeadme had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Cyril "Bones" Garbo, grazed. A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Otto Sonofadeadme's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Otto Sonofadeadme did not make a sound. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Otto Sonofadeadme answered to number 394. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Otto Sonofadeadme helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The medic looked at Otto Sonofadeadme's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-S8. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Otto Sonofadeadme closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Otto Sonofadeadme started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Otto Sonofadeadme's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
The sergeant at S-S8 called out a range and a spot. Otto Sonofadeadme was the only one who hit it. Marek Man was badly wounded.

Otto Sonofadeadme fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-S8. Jonas "Lucky" Garbo was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A bullet clipped Otto Sonofadeadme's helmet at S-S8 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Edmund Mcnamara of the Concord (@zidane_mcnamara).

Otto was hit in the hip at S-S8. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Benedikt "Parson" Cavocato of the Concord (@cavocato). Otto was killed at S-S8 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence.
Gideon "Doc" Sonofadeadme asked about Otto Sonofadeadme on arriving at S-S8. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
thanos_pope: "You're late," said the corporal when Silas Pope arrived on Day 7. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." The sappers took Silas Pope in on a busy morning in S-S12. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Silas Pope bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage. A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close.

A pump handle snapped off in Silas Pope's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles. A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close.

Night raid. Silas Pope crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Silas Pope. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Silas Pope watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools. A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Pope practised asking for bread in the local language. The dugout supplied an audience and several confidently incorrect pronunciations. A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close. Silas Pope got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 487. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Silas Pope kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A letter reached Silas Pope from Belmonte. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.

A local carter understood Silas Pope's request for bread, then explained that the same sentence sounded very much like a request for a beard. A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close.
Silas Pope corrected the phrasebook in pencil. The carter added three useful expressions and refused to translate a fourth suggested by the corporal.

Silas Pope (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Grey Mill. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Hugo Luckystrike: 'Fair trade.' A letter from home found Silas Pope before the night shift. Silas Pope folded it small and kept it close.

Silas Pope gave Teodor "Lucky" Rezasiibiil the last match in the trench. Lucky used it to light a candle so that Silas could finish a letter. Silas Pope got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.

Silas Pope was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen. A short letter reached Silas Pope: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Silas Pope read the part about the dog twice.
Silas reinforced a dugout roof with logs and sandbags. It will not stop a big shell, but it will stop the dust.
thatbadduckk: Day 13. The corporal put Edmund "Brick" Thatbadduckk beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Edmund "Brick" Thatbadduckk and Benedikt Edwinni made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
On sentry duty Edmund "Brick" Thatbadduckk watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Edmund "Brick" Thatbadduckk won before reaching the end of his entry.
Edmund "Brick" Thatbadduckk sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
A round went through Edmund's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Silas Stoll of the Hegemony (@easton.stoll).
theimperialracoon: Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr unpacked his brother's pocket watch at U-F4. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.'

Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr sorted the dressings by lamplight. When the next stretcher arrived, he could find everything without looking. A letter from home reached Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr before dusk. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill is lost. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A Airedale terrier wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr gave it a name: Ginger.

A flare caught Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. A letter from home reached Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr before dusk. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr read it twice and slept a little easier.

A football came over the parapet from the Hegemony side with Ulrich "Lucky" Pavlos's name scratched on it. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr kicked it back. It did not come again. A letter from home reached Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr before dusk. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr read it twice and slept a little easier.

Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket. A letter from home reached Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr before dusk. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr read it twice and slept a little easier.

Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. A letter from home reached Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr before dusk. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr read it twice and slept a little easier.

A second spoon disappeared. Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr anyway.

Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr was hit in the foot through his boot at U-F4. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Henrik "Smokes" Missyandloga of the Hegemony (@missyandlogan). Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.

The House of Theimperialr sent another. Silas Theimperialr, uncle of Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Nobody had the heart to send Ginger away. The Airedale terrier now follows Silas Theimperialr, the same way it followed Zeno "Mole" Theimperialr. Ginger found Silas Theimperialr's lost glove buried in the mud and brought it back, chewed but warm.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Silas read a theatre review while peeling supper. A letter reached Silas with a child's drawing of a soldier. The soldier in the drawing was smiling. Silas tried to as well.
whereewegoing: At the depot, Felix Whereewegoin had practised answering to his name. At Q-S12, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into Q-S12. Felix Whereewegoin has learned to walk bent double.

Felix Whereewegoin tried to remember the price of a loaf in Northwick. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-S12 with the rations. Felix Whereewegoin ate while listening to the revised orders.
Someone had labelled the water bucket 'Soup'. Felix Whereewegoin changed it back after lunch, too late to settle the argument.
Felix Whereewegoin carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Felix Whereewegoin had just lit a cigarette at Q-S12 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Felix Whereewegoin is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Felix Whereewegoin came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
Felix Whereewegoin was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle.
The wound on Felix's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
